meanings.note: + genitive: 'бояться собак'. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be afraid (of), to fear'.

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.

examples.text: Это наш город. Нам здесь бояться некого.
examples.trans: This is our town. We have nobody to fear here.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: In 'до встречи' = until we meet. Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'треча'). Common feminine noun meaning 'meeting' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete
meanings.note: + acc. or infinitive. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'кончить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to finish, to complete', paired with 'заканчивать'.

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.

meanings.en: to beat up, assault physically, thrash
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'бить'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to beat up'.

examples.text: Он избил писателя в зале ресторана.
examples.trans: He beat up the writer in the dining room of the restaurant.

examples.text: А потом он избил писателя Пелевина!

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to set off (used mainly in the imperative)
meanings.note: Поезжай / поезжайте = go!, drive!. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'езжать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go, to drive, to set off', paired with 'поехать'.

examples.text: Поезжай в мэрию и в шредер всё это!
examples.trans: Drive to City Hall and put all of it in the shredder!

examples.text: Ты всё шуточки, что ли, шутишь? Поезжай в мэрию и в шредер всё это!
examples.trans: Are you still cracking jokes? Drive to City Hall and put all of it in the shredder!

Polite request. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'казать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to say, to tell', paired with 'говорить'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ложный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('complicated, difficult').

examples.trans: Danila, let's go. Look, there's nothing complicated.

meanings.note: Это стыдно. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тыдно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
